description.narrative: The purpose of the preparatory study is to develop and prepare a pilot project together with Serving the Nations Mission (STNM), who was chosen as our partner during the partner identification visit to Uganda. The objectives are to lay out a detailed timeline for the pilot project, as well as share knowledge on effectient methods to develop and finalize the pilot project together. The Pilot project will focus on the youths in Nakivale refugee resettlement in Uganda, who feel forgotten, neglected and without hope for the future. “Unforgotten” will be the title of the pilot project, and will focus on raising awareness on trauma and depression in youths living in the refugee resettlement, and how this has contributed to increased suicide among youths. The preparatory study will help us align and discuss how the pilot project can best benefit the primary target group.
